title: Streaming Lattice
tagline: Compare four online quantization strategies for minimizing bitrate while preserving reconstruction fidelity.

curves.label: Uniform Lloydless
curves.code: let B=0,E=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let k=i&255;B+=8;let x=(i%997)/997;let q=Math.round(x*255)/255;E+=Math.abs(x-q);}return B+0.5*E;
curves.name: Uniform Lloydless

curves.label: K-Means Microbatches
curves.code: let centers=[0.1,0.4,0.7,0.9];let B=0,E=0;for(let t=0;t<n;t++){let x=(t%4093)/4093;B+=8;let idx=centers.reduce((best,c,i)=>Math.abs(x-c)<Math.abs(x-centers[best])?i:best,0);centers[idx]+= (x-centers[idx])/(1+(t%32));E+= (x-centers[idx])*(x-centers[idx]);}return B+0.25*E;
curves.name: K-Means Microbatches

curves.label: Entropy-Coded Residuals
curves.code: let B=0,E=0;let prev=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let x=Math.sin(i/17)+Math.cos(i/29);let r=x-prev;let p=Math.max(1e-6,0.1+Math.abs(r));B+=-Math.log2(p);let q=Math.round(r*64)/64;E+=Math.abs(r-q);prev=x;}return B+0.7*E;
curves.name: Entropy-Coded Residuals

curves.label: Adaptive Vector Quantization
curves.code: let codebook=Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>i/16);let B=0,E=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let x=(i*1103515245>>>0)/4294967295;let m=codebook.length;let best=0,min=Infinity;for(let j=0;j<m;j++){let d=Math.abs(x-codebook[j]);if(d<min){min=d;best=j;}}B+=Math.log2(m);codebook[best]+= (x-codebook[best])/(1+(i%64));let q=codebook[best];E+= (x-q)*(x-q);}return B+0.3*E;
curves.name: Adaptive Vector Quantization
